name: Tickglint: ESP32 Smart Clock
tagline: Alarms, timers, sun and moon and festivals on a 12864 LCD, with an Android app, a custom PCB and a browser flasher
description: Tickglint turns an ESP32-S3, ESP32 or ESP32-C3 and a 12864 (ST7920) LCD into a smart desk clock. It has 13 clock faces (including retro LCD watch, nixie tubes, terminal and Pac-Man) with animated backgrounds and screensavers, a calendar, scrolling messages sent from the phone, eight alarms with a buzzer (they ring without Wi-Fi or the phone), timer, stopwatch and pomodoro, four world clocks, sunrise, sunset and moon phase calculated offline, and birthdays and Indian festivals with confetti, sparkle and balloon popups. The Android app pairs over Bluetooth with a PIN shown on the LCD, sets the time from the phone and controls every setting. The firmware installs from this website in one click (web flasher), from the phone over USB-OTG, or with PlatformIO. A custom carrier PCB (KiCad, Gerbers and BOM included) and a colour-coded wiring diagram are part of the project.
features: 13 clock faces picked from a picture gallery: big digits, analog, flip, dot matrix, binary, words, nixie, retro LCD, terminal, Pac-Man and more; 12/24 hour
Eight alarms with repeat days, snooze and buzzer, working with no Wi-Fi
12 animations, animated clock backgrounds and a screensaver; scrolling messages from the app
Timer, stopwatch, pomodoro and hourly chime
Sunrise, sunset and moon phase from your city, calculated on the clock
Birthdays and Indian festivals (2026-2028) with animated popups and a countdown
World clocks, temperature and humidity (BME280), DS3231 RTC support
Android app: Bluetooth setup with a PIN on the LCD, every setting, demo mode, tutorial and guide
Install firmware three ways (web flasher, phone over USB-OTG, PlatformIO) on ESP32-S3, ESP32 and ESP32-C3 boards
Custom ESP32-S3 carrier PCB with backlight and buzzer drivers (fab files included)
Colour-coded wiring diagram (SVG), REST and Bluetooth API, OTA updates
